# mcp-ml-tools

> A Model Context Protocol server that gives Claude Desktop, VS Code, and Cursor practical machine learning engineering tools.

Languages: TypeScript. License: MIT. Source: https://github.com/adeoluo/mcp-ml-tools

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/adeoluo/mcp-ml-tools/blob/main/README.md): motivation, architecture, results, quickstart, usage, design decisions, testing, limitations, roadmap
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/adeoluo/mcp-ml-tools/blob/main/AGENTS.md): layout, commands and conventions for changing the code
- [Architecture diagram](https://github.com/adeoluo/mcp-ml-tools/blob/main/docs/architecture/architecture.mmd): Mermaid source of the component diagram
- [Architecture](https://github.com/adeoluo/mcp-ml-tools/blob/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md)
- [Benchmarks](https://github.com/adeoluo/mcp-ml-tools/blob/main/docs/BENCHMARKS.md)
- [Threat model](https://github.com/adeoluo/mcp-ml-tools/blob/main/docs/THREAT_MODEL.md)
- [0001: Official SDK, stdio first, stateless Streamable HTTP](https://github.com/adeoluo/mcp-ml-tools/blob/main/docs/adr/0001-official-sdk-and-stateless-http.md)
- [0002: A small built-in byte-level BPE instead of provider tokenizers](https://github.com/adeoluo/mcp-ml-tools/blob/main/docs/adr/0002-built-in-bpe.md)
- [0003: Filesystem access is off unless an allowlisted root is configured](https://github.com/adeoluo/mcp-ml-tools/blob/main/docs/adr/0003-filesystem-allowlist.md)
- [0004: Paired bootstrap with a centered null, plus McNemar for binary scores](https://github.com/adeoluo/mcp-ml-tools/blob/main/docs/adr/0004-bootstrap-and-mcnemar.md)
- [Changelog](https://github.com/adeoluo/mcp-ml-tools/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): release history

## Source

- [src/errors.ts](https://github.com/adeoluo/mcp-ml-tools/blob/main/src/errors.ts): An error caused by invalid tool input; reported to the client as a tool error, not a crash.
- [src/prices.ts](https://github.com/adeoluo/mcp-ml-tools/blob/main/src/prices.ts): Default model price table.
- [src/random.ts](https://github.com/adeoluo/mcp-ml-tools/blob/main/src/random.ts): Mulberry32: a small, fast, seedable 32-bit pseudo-random number generator.
- [src/tools/bpe-corpus.ts](https://github.com/adeoluo/mcp-ml-tools/blob/main/src/tools/bpe-corpus.ts): Small original English and code corpus used to train the built-in byte-level BPE vocabulary.
- [src/tools/bpe-merges.ts](https://github.com/adeoluo/mcp-ml-tools/blob/main/src/tools/bpe-merges.ts): Generated by scripts/train-vocabulary.mjs.
- [src/tools/bpe-settings.ts](https://github.com/adeoluo/mcp-ml-tools/blob/main/src/tools/bpe-settings.ts): Number of merges learned for the built-in vocabulary (vocabulary size is 256 + merges).
- [src/tools/bpe.ts](https://github.com/adeoluo/mcp-ml-tools/blob/main/src/tools/bpe.ts): Byte-level byte pair encoding (BPE): a small, dependency-free implementation of the scheme used by GPT-2 style tokenizers.
- [src/tools/injection.ts](https://github.com/adeoluo/mcp-ml-tools/blob/main/src/tools/injection.ts): Rule-based prompt-injection, obfuscation, secret, and personal information (PII) detection.
